title: The Footstep Distance Contradiction
description:
📻 Decoded Radio Transmission:
Witness A: 'I heard the killer take 100 heavy paces walking down the 10-foot scullery hallway.'
question: Which witness is lying?
hints: 100 paces in a 10-foot hallway means each step is 1.2 inches long.
solution: Taking 100 paces in a 10-foot hallway is absurd. Witness A lied.
